label: PRIVATION_BASED_TRUTHMAKING_TEST_2: The test uses the existing q.48 conditionals: a due good is…
definition: The test uses the existing q.48 conditionals: a due good is missing, this is evil under EvilIsPrivationReading, and evil in a subject makes the evil-exists sentence true in every practice under EvilIsAsPropositionalTruthReading. This is the adopted Catholic test condition, not an attribution of this account to quasi-realists or a claim that every evil is morally wrong.
note: The source readings themselves are independently recorded. Combining them with varying practices is an explicit test requirement to test explanatory-order independence, not a new source interpretation.
